Name: Custom NPC Ivaras - Rasmodia Dialogue Compatibility
Author: TreyToor
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Dialogue fix for people using the Rasmodia mod. Name and pronouns edited with minimal changes made and only one line being altered.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Unzip file and copy paste contents into original mod to overwrite i18n file. I'll look into what i need to make a CP version.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Rasmodia as Ivaras' mentor acknowledged.





Special Thanks to starfyzz for creating [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44610]Custom NPC Ivaras[/url] & Nom0ri for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romanceable Rasmodia - Female Wizard[/url]
